Put Your Skills to the Test! 🔬

You’ve learned about mean, median, standard deviation, outliers, and scatterplots. Now it’s time to practice with real water quality scenarios!

The Exercise

We’ve created one comprehensive exercise that covers everything you learned in this module. You’ll analyze real water quality data from multiple streams and make recommendations.

What you’ll do: - Calculate means, medians, and standard deviations - Identify outliers in sensor data - Create scatterplots to find relationships - Make decisions about water safety

📊

How to Use Google Colab

First time using Google Colab? It’s easy!

  1. Click the link above
  2. Sign in with your Google account (if you aren’t already)
  3. Click “Copy to Drive” to save your own copy
  4. Follow the instructions in the notebook
  5. Run code cells by clicking the ▶️ play button

You don’t need to install anything - it all runs in your web browser!

What to Expect

The exercise notebook includes:

  • 📝 Step-by-step instructions
  • 💡 Hints when you need help
  • ✅ Code to check your answers
  • 🎯 Real water quality scenarios
  • 🌊 Data from streams, rivers, and creeks

Time needed: About 15-20 minutes

Tips for Success

  • Read each question carefully
  • Try the code yourself before looking at hints
  • Run your code often to test it
  • Add comments to explain your thinking
  • Don’t worry about making mistakes - that’s how you learn!

Need Help?

  • Each section has hints you can reveal
  • Example code is provided for tricky parts
  • Ask your teacher or classmates
  • Remember: Getting stuck is part of learning!

Ready?

🚀 Start the Exercise Now!

After you complete this exercise, you’ll be ready to analyze your own water quality data from sensor buoys! 🎉
